pcs.pc_description: check with the higher authority whether the materials pertain to the required work or not
check whether tarpaulin is properly tied and the materials are properly covered
ensure that one higher authority and one security guard are present during loading / unloading of goods or material
avoid use of any hook to avoid damage to goods
check the condition of the packages if any, for the packages are opened or damaged the same to be unloaded only after the approval of the higher authority
unload the cone / cheese bags/ boxes and store the same at the place earmarked for the same.
Ensure to store / stack the bags / boxes in such a way that the markings on the bags/boxes are readable.
unload the empty beams from the vehicle without damaging the same
store the unloaded empty beams at the reserve place

ensure the safety methods are adopted accordingly so that no damage is caused to people or material, whether it is manual unloading with or without proper loading point or unloading using forklift, chain block, electrical hoist or any other equipment.
check the condition of the empty beams, before bringing them to the sizing machine and handing over the same to the sizer.
peel off the old beam tickets from the empty beams
clean the empty beams thoroughly, so that no stain or rust is there, before they are brought to the sizing machine and handed over to the sizer
paste fresh beam tickets after the sized beams are unloaded from the sizing machine, as per the advice of the higher authority
properly wrap the sized beams as per the advice of the higher authority so that no warp sheet is exposed outside
store the sized beams in the place earmarked for them
store the sized beams in such a way that there is no damage to the warp National sheet and they are easily traceable sheet and they are easily traceable
carry the sized beams to the loom sheds as per the advice of the higher authority using beam trolleys only
ensure that there is no damage entertained to the beams while carrying to the loom shed . safely hand over of the sized beams after storing them at the place as advised by the loom shed authority
hand over the GRN slip to the higher authority in the sizing department
get the list of the materials (from the higher authority) to be loaded in the vehicle.
check whether tarpaulin is there and whether the same is in good condition in the vehicle in which the materials need to be loaded.
check the condition of the interior of the vehicle. if it is in bad condition, no materials should be loaded in the said vehicle.
check that the interior of the said vehicle is clean. if necessary, cleaning has to be done. floor covers should be spread to protect the materials from staining
check the availability of the materials to be loaded, as per the list given by the higher authority
take the materials from the stacked place safely and without damaging the other materials
check that loading takes place in the presence of a higher authority and a security guard
ensure that all the materials are loaded without damaging the packages
keep the hands clean during material handling & use hand gloves while working
work as a team while carrying out the works
maintain clean habits (abstain from drinking, abstain from smoking etc.) while being on duty
ensure that the loading point is free from other hazards
ensure that the trolleys move freely without any obstruction, by cleaning the fluff in the wheels or by changing the worn out/ damaged wheels
ensure that the weighing scales work properly. for any deviation should bring the same to the knowledge of the higher authorities
ensure proper functioning of chain block, fork lift, hoist etc. for any deviation, should bring the same to the knowledge of the higher authorities
